regressionTests.adapter: fake render endpoints; no real audio mutations

reviewFixes: Recognize Apollo sequential per-role Console/Steam cleanup without overwriting saved originals
Persist the final idle baseline before deleting the recovery journal; retain recovery on write failure

realWindowsRouting.trigger: synthetic lifecycle log with real Windows endpoints

limitations: Not tested on other physical PCs or phones
Undocumented Windows IPolicyConfig interface and specific Apollo log format
Manual selection of the original Console endpoint during the cleanup guard is indistinguishable from Apollo cleanup
Very brief driver loss and return between observations can be missed
Hard-kill recovery occurs on a later helper start
Unsigned prerelease; clean scans do not guarantee absence of threats
